title: Chapter 506
paragraphs: Chapter 506
Episode 139. Threat (5)
Chiiing-!
Zephyrin's leaping ax-sword emitted a purple magic aura.
At the same time, signal flares were shot from various places in the desert and Lomin Forest. The colorful magical signals that dyed the sky in an instant colored the battlefield like a festival.
"Found! The enemy has been found... Kaaak!"
The shouting magician met his death before he could finish his words. The purple sword energy shot by Zephyrin had cut his body in half.
Although the morning light was breaking, the visibility was still hazy due to the sandstorm, and the magicians waiting in Lomin Forest were maintaining their guard with extreme tension.
They made a mistake due to excessive tension.
Firing signal flares without accurately identifying the enemy was a clear, fatal mistake.
"Regroup! Regroup! They're planning to break through by force, stop them!"
Zephyrin's sword energy mercilessly battered the forest.
For the first few seconds, they were desperately fending off the sword energy, but the commanders soon realized something was off.
"It's not an aura or spirit energy... It's magic! That's not a Runcandel! It's a demon, a Kinzelo!"
"How many are there?"
"One confirmed! Identity unknown, assumed to be female!"
"Damn it, the signal flares... Ugh!"
Thunk!
In the blink of an eye, Zephyrin closed the distance and slashed the throat of the talking commander with a grin.
"Haha, what can you do if you're all so stupid?"
The other magicians who saw her were shocked, their eyes nearly popping out.
"You're... Zephyrin!?"
"Grade 3 researcher, Zephyrin...?"
-Sir Belakt, we cannot punish Zephyrin.
-I know. I just asked if the vice-captain had any clever ideas. If the captain's recovery is delayed, the mission will be delayed as well.
-... In that case, I'll personally meet with her and ask her to work as a spy among Zipple's ranks for a while. This seems to be the most we can ask of Zephyrin.
After forcibly using the captain's power at Black Kings Mountain.
Zephyrin had been working as a spy, becoming a Grade 3 researcher of Zipple in response to Bishkel's request.
That's why her appearance was an even bigger shock to the magicians of Lomin Forest.
"That's right, it's me, Zephyrin. Oh, come to think of it, the commander I just killed had a record of persistently targeting me, huh? Ugh, I shouldn't have killed him so easily!"
"What kind of betrayal is this?!"
"You seem to be confused and can't grasp the situation, but how is this betrayal looking at me? I was a spy from the beginning. It's just that you all were so captivated by my beauty."
"Ugh!"
The magicians were swept away like leaves by Zephyrin's ax-sword moving in all directions.
With each swing, at least three or more were killed, but the number of magicians gathering in response to the initial signal flare was more than a thousand times that.
Circular barriers were deployed, and offensive magic rained down from all directions.
And confusion among those watching the signal flares from the desert was growing.
"Signal flares went off in Lomin Forest!"
"Did they find the Runcandel?"
"What? Yellow signal flares indicating a mistake are also going off."
"Black signal flares signifying internal betrayal are the same."
"What on earth is happening in Lomin Forest?"

From Drakka to the Sota Desert and Lomin Forest, all the way to the border of the Federation, all Zipple members in the area were mentally occupied trying to read the chaotic content of the signal flares.
Octavia had no time to spare since she was still dealing with Grenil, but Drakka and the Wraith teams had to make a quick decision.
"Was the initial escape to Kuta Forest a diversion?"
"This could be a double diversion, or it could be another unilateral decision by the Kinzelo."
"But no traces of their escape have been found near Kuta Forest yet."
"Captain, make a decision!"
The captains of the Wraith teams made their decision.
"Teams 1, 2, and 3 will head to Lomin Forest. The rest will continue searching Kuta Forest!"
Teams 1, 2, and 3.
Dragons carrying twenty Wraith members turned their direction.
Now it was Jin's turn to choose.
'The entire Wraith team won't turn back. Since the signals are unclear, they can't completely give up searching around Kuta Forest.'
Huff, phew.
Jane's rough breaths eased after taking a painkiller.
"Kid, that crazy demon dragon is definitely drawing attention. Let's move too. Hey, Black Knight. Can you endure it? Can you go?"
"Yes, Lord Murakan. I can fight."
"What are you going to fight with that body? Are you just showing off? Get on my back. Hey, Yona, you carry her again."
Surprisingly, Jane obediently climbed onto Murakan's back.
"Showing such a pathetic sight to the guardian deity of our clan..."
"Don't be too embarrassed. Even the stronger knights of the old Runcandel vomited and pooped on my back, making all sorts of fuss."
Which direction should they start moving?
As Zephyrin started to break through, the forces were gathering to the right, so it was an obvious choice to choose another direction.
Everyone thought so, but Jin came to a different conclusion.
"Let's hold on for a moment. And we'll break through in the same direction as Zephyrin."
"Kid, what are you talking about? Why did you tell Zephyrin to attract attention if we were going to do that?"
"What?"
"With the Wraith teams coming, why are you suggesting we wait?"
"Oh! Jin, do you have some other idea?"
The group members questioning.
"The goal of the Wraith teams coming to support Lomin Forest is not to suppress or assassinate Zephyrin. Their top priority is to find us, whether the magicians die or not."
At those words, the group's eyes widened.
"In other words, the Wraith teams will search the Lomin Forest area while avoiding combat with Zephyrin as much as possible. Fighting Zephyrin would only interfere with their search."
Jin was right.
Despite the urgency, the group couldn't help but admire.
It was incomprehensible how he could come to such insights in such a short time.
"Wow... you're really insane, so cool I feel like I'm going to faint."

"At the moment when the forces are most concentrated on Zephyrin, we will follow her path exactly. And we will quietly take out some enemies clinging to us as we escape Lomin Forest. We should refrain from using aura as much as possible, so we won't be distinguished from Zephyrin."
The magic energy that was now wildly cutting through the forest and magicians was emphasizing Zephyrin's presence.
If their aura mixes in between, the group would be immediately exposed to the Wraith teams.
"I'll give a signal when I think it's the right time."
Hidden in the sandstorm, the group waited for Jin to speak again.
Jin opened his mouth after 5 minutes had passed, right after Zephyrin had caused a storm with her magic energy.
"Let's go!"
The Runcandels rushed towards Lomin Forest.

Magicians chasing Zephyrin from the beginning were visible. They were so preoccupied with reading the situation ahead and passing it to the left and right that they couldn't even notice the Runcandels' swords falling on their necks.
Swish, thud!
The sword blade doesn't become dull just because it doesn't use aura. With the magicians' lifeless necks falling behind, the Runcandels clenched their teeth and ran.
"Ugh!"
"Ru, Rune Can. Cough!"
It was desperate.
Throughout the run, the Runcandels prayed inwardly for the forest to end, to escape safely.
Fortunately, the magicians didn't notice them, and if they did, they were immediately killed.
Swoosh-!
After running for a while, they heard the sharp sound of shockwaves as dragons carrying Wraith teams flew overhead. They had just arrived over Lomin Forest.
As Jin predicted, the Wraith teams didn't engage with Zephyrin but searched the area. The shadows of the forest hid the Runcandels from them.
"Gasping, panting, gasping!"
"Haah!"
Eventually, when the morning light was completely shining.

The Runcandels managed to escape from Lomin Forest. Their bodies were covered in the blood and sweat of the mages, as well as the splinters of wood and dust from the ground, but no one had died or suffered further injuries.
The mages in the forest were still chasing Zepherin up to the border.
Moreover, because the damage caused by Zepherin was much greater than what the Wraith Squadron had expected, some of the wraiths who had come to Lomin Forest were now pursuing Zepherin as well.
Once they crossed the central border of the Federation, the chances of escaping to Lutero West Sea would increase dramatically.
However, it was inevitable that the group would eventually be detected by the Wraith Squadron.
Before they could even choose a new escape route, the Runcandels were confronted by gray-robed figures aiming their staffs at them.
'...Ten of them?'
Jin calmly counted the number of wraiths.
Ten Wraith Squadron members.
Those who had chased Zepherin would not return. Instead, the wraiths in Kuta Forest would rush to their aid once the battle began.
Whooosh-!
Their squad leader fired a flare, a red signal indicating that the target had been found.
"Lord Murakan."
Jane opened her mouth.
"Please put me down."
Her submission to Murakan's carrying was for a reason.
It was to conserve her remaining strength for this moment. Jin's reason for trying to save Jane at all costs was the same.
It was for times like this.
The loyalty of the Black Knight... was needed.
Without speaking, Jin and Jane had been prepared since the moment Zepherin agreed to attract attention.
"Knight Jane."
"I know, 12th generation."
"…I see."
"Your decision to bring me here was correct. Sandra Zipple, although we are enemies, I must thank you. The painkillers are helping a bit."
Jane drew her sword and stepped in front of the group.
Jin couldn't bring himself to say sorry.
"I won't forget your sacrifice today, Black Knight."
"A death devoted to the family is more valuable than life itself. So this is not a sacrifice, but my greatest honor."
The trembling that seemed like it would break her any moment ceased.
Jane's sword was calmly and firmly aimed at the enemies.
"I won't be able to buy much time. Hurry on. You must survive to protect my honor."
There were more words she had kept inside.
But Jane didn't let those words out.
'12th generation, the truth is, I wanted to serve you if I had the chance. Not the 2nd generation...'
For a moment, Jin looked at her retreating figure and shouted the name of his older brother.
2nd generation of the family, Joshua Runcandel!
Then he added these words:
"Will you just stand by? Help with Jane's last battle. That's the only way to wash away some of your disgrace and betrayal."
